newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia RAMS make unique private placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia RAMS make unique private placement.

text.p: RAMS, one of Australia's largest non-bank home lenders, said it made a A$18.4 million private placement of securitised floating rate bonds on Wednesday through lead manager J.P. Morgan.
The RAMS Net Interest Margin Series A bonds (NIMS) effectively securitise a portion of the group's future net interest income stream, it said.
RAMS said the structure of the issue is believed to be a world first, and no bond of this type has ever been placed in Australia.
The paper is provisionally rated A minus by Standard & Poor's and will be issued by RAMS Net Interest Margin Ltd.
"Every mortgage we write costs us money up front, but NIMs will allow us to spread that burden more evenly over the life of the loan," said RAMS finance director Robin Redfern.

He added that by securitising a portion of the interest that RAMS will receive in the future to fund the group's up front origination costs, RAMS was able to raise more efficient and cheaper capital funding.
